_comment: Ship tuning (flight_core::ShipTuning): the axis flight model (spike 13) and the parts around it. Every field required. TODO(initiator): every value here is a placeholder, not designed; the landing mode's band and touchdown speed (precision); cap_turns on or off (F8 switches it in the game until the next reload of this file). Ship space: forward -Z, right +X, up +Y. cruise_speed m/s for full stick in any direction (stick normalised into a ball), in full atmosphere; decoupled thrust stops at the same caps; boost_speed_* m/s caps at full boost (at least cruise_speed); space: the same caps out of the atmosphere, blended by the air density. accel m/s² per axis and direction in vacuum, atmosphere_thrust the share of it at density 1 (with the assist on the thrust also holds against gravity and drag, so a side below 9.81 cannot hold the ship rolled on its side); boost_accel multipliers at full boost (the brake always gets them). linear_decay and angular_decay 1/s: the assist asks for decay times the error (saturated far from the goal, exponential near it). rate rad/s at full stick (pitch and yaw share an ellipse), rate_over_speed: (speed as a share of the cruise cap, share of the rates), boost_rate multipliers, angular_accel rad/s². precision (only in landing mode, K): full below full_below m clearance, off above off_above m (the clearance counts less the distance the thrust upwards needs to stop the descent), speed cap in m/s along the ground (climbing away from the ground is not capped), landing_share of it for the descent (also the touchdown speed of the descent limit that is always on: no faster descent than the upward thrust can stop above the ground), rate_share of the turn rates. g_safety: limit in g per direction of the felt acceleration (forward and up press the pilot into the seat), the thrust stays inside it; cap_turns also scales pitch and yaw down at speed so a coupled turn (plus holding against gravity) stays inside the limit (the nose follows the velocity; off, the velocity slips behind the nose). drag_k: quadratic drag a = k * density * v². ramp_curve: (ramp progress 0..1, deflection cap), the ramp times are seconds to full deflection. decouple_time: seconds the switch to decoupled (C) blends over. boost_capacitor (#90): drain_time s full to empty while boosting (0 = no capacitor, boost always there as decided in #24), recharge_time s empty to full after recharge_delay s without boost, start_charge needed to start a boost (a running one lasts until empty), strength_curve: (charge, share of the full boost). restart_while_held: held through empty, the boost starts again by itself at the start charge (weak pulses); false needs a new press (#104 point 9). TODO(initiator): restart_while_held, capacitor or speed stage by default, all times, weaken (linear curve) or cut off (flat curve), see issue #90. landing_slope_limit (#92): degrees; a ship that touches down on ground at most this steep keeps its spot until thrust (any input but down), on steeper ground it is not held.
